question_record.context: During an investigation of possible ransomware activity, several file system changes were detected on the device, including the files `get-userprttoken.ps1`, `characterical.zip`, and `characterical.zip.lockbit`. These changes suggest potential ransomware activity due to the known malicious extensions. The suspected ransomware attack was linked to account with Name `dp5hn` and associated IP address `99.83.111.100`.
question_record.question: An alert also indicated possible lateral movement associated with this incident. Can you identify the IP address of the device where lateral movement was observed?
solution: There is possible ransomware activity on the device with AadDeviceId `e5799261-6720-4297-961e-bd9ca4275033`.
Suspicious lateral movement was detected with a network event involving IP address `83.162.58.168`.

159.name: Possible ransomware activity based on a known malicious extension
159.description: Numerous file system changes have been observed on the device. The changes involve appending a file extension that is known and observed in past ransomware incidents. This file system activity might be indicative of mass encryption of files by ransomware.

103.name: Possible lateral movement
103.description: Lateral movement on another device was observed in close time proximity to a suspicious network event on this device. This could mean that an attacker is attempting to move laterally across devices to gather data or elevate privileges. This alert was triggered based on a Microsoft Defender for Endpoint alert.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Device_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
